summary: Conditional AI-driver state setter: compares the current state stored at this+0x2C (this+44) with the incoming value a2. When they differ, it calls AIDriverStateTransition with the global state array dword_5EB978, the per-driver state pointer at this+0x0, and the old/new state pair, then writes a2 into this+0x2C. Equal states short-circuit with no transition notification.

operations.description: Read current state value v3 from this+0x2C (this+44).
Guard: proceed only when v3 != a2; equal states skip the transition and the write.

Call AIDriverStateTransition(dword_5EB978, *(int **)this, v3, a2) to notify the state-transition system of the old -> new change, passing the global state array and the driver's state pointer at this+0x0.
Store the new state a2 into this+0x2C (this+44).
